Tokyo Metropolitan Government Main Build.en: Kenzo Tange’s 243-metre twin towers, clad in pale concrete, anchor the dawn with civic geometry and elevated observation decks.
Tokyo Metropolitan Government Main Build.zh-CN: 丹下健三设计的243米双塔覆以浅色混凝土，以纪念性几何和空中观景台迎接黎明。

Shinjuku Park Tower.en: Park Hyatt Tokyo rises as a stepped stack of granite volumes, its landscaped terraces translating vertical density into layered quiet.
Shinjuku Park Tower.zh-CN: 东京柏悦酒店所在的新宿公园塔由层叠花岗岩体量构成，阶台式平台把垂直密度转译为景观露台与静谧层次。

Shinjuku Nomura Building.en: A 210-metre white tower articulated by narrow vertical fins, its repetitive façade turning office floors into a precise urban barcode.
Shinjuku Nomura Building.zh-CN: 210米高的白色巨塔布满细密竖向鳍片，重复的立面像一张精确的城市条形码。

Shinjuku Center Building.en: A 228-metre steel-and-glass corporate monolith whose disciplined curtain wall captures shifting weather and daylight.
Shinjuku Center Building.zh-CN: 228米高的钢与玻璃企业巨构，以严谨幕墙捕捉东京不断变化的天气与天光。

Shinjuku Mitsui Building.en: A 225-metre dark tower made legible by monumental diagonal X-bracing, a structural signature that turns the skyline into circuitry.
Shinjuku Mitsui Building.zh-CN: 225米高的深色塔楼以巨型X形斜撑清晰可辨，结构签名把天际线化作流动电路。

Mode Gakuen Cocoon Tower.en: A 204-metre cocoon-like tower wrapped in diagonal steel strands and translucent envelopes, softening the corporate skyline with woven motion.
Mode Gakuen Cocoon Tower.zh-CN: 204米高的茧形塔楼由交织斜向钢构与半透明表皮包裹，为商务天际线注入柔和的编织动势。

JR Shinjuku Miraina Tower.en: A 168-metre rail-linked slab above Shinjuku Station, compressing offices and transit into one sleek, heavily used urban threshold.
JR Shinjuku Miraina Tower.zh-CN: 168米高的里程碑塔立于新宿站上方，将办公空间与轨道交通压叠成高流量的城市门槛。

Tokyu Kabukicho Tower.en: A 225-metre glass tower crowned by a luminous spire, its theatrical fountain and cinema signs forming Kabukicho’s neon gateway.
Tokyu Kabukicho Tower.zh-CN: 225米高的玻璃塔以发光尖顶收束，戏剧性喷泉和影院招牌共同构成歌舞伎町的霓虹门户。
